claims.claim: Astronauts show higher hip fracture rates after spaceflights longer than ninety days than after shorter missions.
claims.episode_span: Astronauts show higher hip fracture rates after spaceflights longer than ninety days than after shorter missions.
claims.source_title: 90-plus-day spaceflights linked to higher rates of hip fractures in astronauts
claims.supporting_quote: New research has found that the rate of hip fractures among astronauts after spaceflights lasting more than 90 days was higher than after shorter spaceflights or among people who were not astronauts.

claims.claim: Application of S1P or S1PR1 selective agonist SEW2871 to human pluripotent stem cells yielded more than ninety percent differentiation into cardiomyocytes.
claims.episode_span: Application of S1P or S1PR1 selective agonist SEW2871 to human pluripotent stem cells yielded more than ninety percent differentiation into cardiomyocytes.
claims.source_title: Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology restores heart after myocardial infarction with lab-grown muscle graft
claims.supporting_quote: When S1P or an S1PR1-selective agonist (SEW2871) was applied to human pluripotent stem cells, more than 90% differentiated into cardiomyocytes.
